scenes.headline: 1,400+ flaws in one month
scenes.say: Windows users: in October, Microsoft fixed over fourteen hundred security flaws. In one month.

scenes.headline: CVEs in one Patch Tuesday
scenes.body: Counts range from 1,411 to 1,417. October 2025 had 180.
scenes.say: Depending on who counted, it's between fourteen eleven and fourteen seventeen. A year earlier, October had one hundred eighty.

scenes.headline: More than all of 2025
scenes.body: One month beat Microsoft's total for the whole of last year.
scenes.say: That single month beat Microsoft's total for the whole of last year.

scenes.headline: AI is finding more bugs
scenes.body: Microsoft says AI-assisted research now contributes to vulnerability discovery.
scenes.say: Why? Microsoft says AI-assisted research now contributes to finding these bugs. More bugs found means more fixes.

scenes.headline: One was exploited
scenes.body: CVE-2026-96951: a Windows Shell bug that skips the download warning.
scenes.say: And at least one was already being exploited: a Windows Shell bug that skips the warning on downloaded files.

scenes.headline: Big updates aren't bad news.
scenes.body: More holes found means more holes closed. Install, don't postpone.
scenes.say: Analyst note: a bigger update doesn't mean Windows got worse. It means more holes are being found and closed. Microsoft's advice is to install updates as soon as possible.

scenes.headline: Do this tonight
scenes.say: Tonight: open Settings, then Windows Update. Check for updates. Restart when asked.

scenes.headline: The security story behind the headline.
scenes.say: Sources are in the description. Follow Securidge.
